title.en: Revaluation and accumulated profits on admission
title.kn: ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭಗಳು

hook.en: The firm's building was bought years ago for less than half its price today. Should the new partner share in that gain?
hook.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟಡವನ್ನು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಅರ್ಧಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಬೇಕೇ?

objectives.en: Distribute reserves and accumulated profits or losses

narration.en: The firm's building was bought years ago for less than half its price today. Should the new partner share in that gain? No. Gains and losses up to the date of admission belong to the old partners.
narration.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟಡವನ್ನು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಅರ್ಧಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಬೇಕೇ? ಇಲ್ಲ. ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ದಿನದವರೆಗಿನ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Increase in an asset or decrease in a liability is a gain: credit the Revaluation Account. Decrease in an asset or increase in a liability (including unrecorded liabilities) is a loss: debit it. The balance, profit or loss, is transferred to the old partners' capital accounts in their old ratio.
body.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಣೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ ಲಾಭ — ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಆಸ್ತಿ ಇಳಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಣೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ ನಷ್ಟ — ಖರ್ಚು. ಶಿಲ್ಕನ್ನು ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Balance to old partners in old ratio

title.en: Reserves and accumulated profits or losses

body.en: General reserve, credit balance of Profit and Loss Account and the excess of Workmen Compensation Reserve over the claim are credited to old partners in the old ratio. Debit balance of Profit and Loss Account and deferred revenue expenditure (such as advertisement suspense) are debited to them in the old ratio.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೀಸಲು, ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆಯ ಜಮಾ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಮಾ. ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆಯ ಖರ್ಚು ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದೂಡಿದ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚು.

problem.en: A and B share 3:2 and admit C. Building is appreciated by ₹30,000; stock is reduced by ₹5,000; a provision for doubtful debts of ₹2,000 is created; creditors of ₹1,000 will not be claimed. The balance sheet shows General Reserve ₹20,000. Find the revaluation result and each old partner's credit.

answer.en: Revaluation profit ₹24,000; A is credited ₹26,400 and B ₹17,600 in all

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share 3:2 and admit C. Building is appreciated by ₹30,000; stock is reduced by ₹5,000; a provision for doubtful debts of ₹2,000 is created; creditors of ₹1,000 will not be claimed. The balance sheet shows General Reserve ₹20,000. Find the revaluation result and each old partner's credit.

heading.en: Gain on the right, pain on the left

body.en: In the Revaluation Account, gains are credited (right side) and losses debited (left side). The new partner never shares in it.

narration.en: Gain on the right, pain on the left. In the Revaluation Account, gains are credited (right side) and losses debited (left side). The new partner never shares in it.

points.en: Revaluation gains and losses belong to old partners in the old ratio.
points.kn: ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನದ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ.

points.en: Reserves and accumulated profits are credited to old partners.
points.kn: ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ.

points.en: Accumulated losses are debited to old partners.

homework.en: Prepare the Revaluation Account and capital accounts for the worked example.

narration.en: Recap. Revaluation gains and losses belong to old partners in the old ratio. Reserves and accumulated profits are credited to old partners. Accumulated losses are debited to old partners.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನದ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ. ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು.
